title: Head of People and Compliance
leads: The Recruiters from day one. At scale, the Trainers and the Compliance and Safety Manager.
where: The Cairo office and the sites, where the people and the papers are
hours: Office days, with site visits. Reachable the same day for a Portfolio Manager with an empty seat or an audit that failed
summary: You own the people side end to end, and the checks that keep us safe and compliant. Every seat filled, every file complete.

posting.headline: Head of People and Compliance (recruiting, training, and audits), Cairo
posting.about: KMSC runs the field operations behind a large artificial intelligence project, at industrial sites across Cairo. We are growing from hundreds of people to thousands, and each one needs a complete file before day one. You own recruiting, training, onboarding screening, and the audits, reporting to the Chief of Staff.
do: Fill every open seat with the Recruiters: operators, site leads, Portfolio Managers, runners, and office roles.
Run onboarding screening, so nobody starts without an ID copy, proof of age, and the signed paperwork.
Train every new operator, site lead, and Portfolio Manager before their first shift, and retrain a site team when its quality slips.
Run the audits: employee files, incident reports, data protection, insurance certificates, and site safety checklists.
Send the Chief of Staff the open seats, the days to fill, and the audit results every week.
Build the team under you as the numbers require: Trainers and a Compliance and Safety Manager at scale.
need: You have run people operations or human resources for a field workforce in Egypt: hundreds of workers, high turnover, fast hiring.
Careful with papers and calm under an audit, so a missing form is caught before anyone else sees it.
You have built and run a training programme, not only attended one.
Straight with candidates and staff about the job, the pay, and the rules.
Clear and short in writing, in Arabic and English.
plus: You know Egyptian labour law, social insurance, and data protection in practice.
You have run a referral programme or hired managers as well as workers.
offer: A steady monthly wage, paid on time.
Two Recruiters under you from the start, and a team that grows with the numbers.
Every role, rule, and checklist already written down.
A company that follows its rules, so your audits change things.
posting.apply: Send your name, where you live, a phone number, and the teams you have hired and run. We call back within two working days.

offer.heading: Offer of employment
paragraphs: We are pleased to offer you the position of Head of People and Compliance at KMSC. You will report to {manager}, the Chief of Staff.
Your start date is {start}. In your first weeks you take over the open seats and the wearer files from {manager}, meet every Portfolio Manager, and run your first audit.

terms.v: The Cairo office and the sites, where the people and the papers are

terms.label: Hours
terms.v: Office days, with site visits. Reachable the same day for a Portfolio Manager with an empty seat or an audit that failed

conditions: A copy of your national ID.
Your signature on the rules, the consent form, and the fraud briefing.
One account in your own name. Accounts are never shared.
expect: Every open seat has a candidate in the pipeline within a week.
Nobody starts without complete papers, whoever referred them.
Every audit is done on time, and what it finds is fixed within the week.
offer.closing: Please sign below to accept this offer. We look forward to working with you.

handbook.purpose: The client pays for accepted hours from people with complete papers, on sites that pass their checks. Sites open, people leave, books grow, and every file has to be right the first time. You own who joins, how they are trained, and the audits that prove we did it properly. Mano owns the office. You own the people and the checks.
outcomes: Every open seat has a candidate within a week and a person within the target.
Nobody starts before the onboarding gate is complete.
Every audit is on time, and every finding is fixed within the week.
Every new hire is trained before their first shift.
daily: Morning. The open seats list with the Recruiters. Which are new, late, or starting this week.
All day. Screenings, site visits, and audits. The papers are checked where the people are.
Same day. A Portfolio Manager with an empty seat hears from you today, with a name or a date.
Same day. An incident report or a failed check is read the day it comes in.
weekly: Once a week. The open seats, the days to fill, and the audit results, to Mano.
Once a week. One site audited in person: files, consent, safety, insurance.
Once a week. The bench of every book with Moharam. Under 10% means hiring now.
monthly: Month end. Hires that stayed, hires that left, and why.
Month end. Every wearer file complete. Every certificate in date.
Month end. Referral rewards to Ahmed Alaa for payment.
standards: No ID copy, no consent, no start. Whoever referred them.
One account per person, in their own name, created before the first day.
Nobody under 18. Nobody removed for fraud comes back, under any name.
An audit finding is fixed within the week, or Mano hears why.
Legal questions go to outside counsel through Mano. You run the checklists, not the law.
To anyone outside the company, the work is an AI project. Nothing more.
never: A first day without complete papers.
A removed worker hired again under another name.
An audit finding left open without a date and a name.
Saying the client's name to anyone outside the company ends the job.

firstMonth.what: With Mano. Every open seat, every wearer file, every checklist, and the Recruiters.
Meet every Portfolio Manager. Run one onboarding screening and one site audit yourself.
Fill five seats. Send Mano your first weekly report.
Every file complete, every audit on the calendar. Mano signs you off.

measures: Days from a seat opening to a signed first day.
Hires with complete papers before day one. All of them.
Audits done on time, and findings fixed within the week.
handbook.call: Mano for anything you cannot settle, and for outside counsel. Moharam for the bench and where people are needed. The Portfolio Managers for their seats and their screenings. Ahmed Alaa for referral rewards and the consent files.
